enter: disable player interaction and gameplay presentation
load A0125B stream and tsm003 sound environment
hide POK2/POS2 and resident FUKU while the activity owns presentation
nativeLifecycle.activity: run slot 0 through the native activity wait boundary
exit: restore f1doujou/BGM009 room audio, camera, gameplay, and interaction

actors.IWAO: archive-local IWA_M.CHRM body variant with shared exact IWA texture pack
actors.JAKR: canonical JKA_M.CHRM (byte-identical to the archive member)

faces.IWAO: global exact IWA_F.MT5/IWA_FTBL.BIN and native TALK poses
faces.JAKR: global exact JKA_F.MT5/JKA_FTBL.BIN and native TALK poses

runtimePolicy.world: reuse the JHD0 Hazuki grounds composition and coordinate root
runtimePolicy.actors: package-local body variants use generic package actor ownership; byte-identical canonical bodies are not duplicated
runtimePolicy.audio: play the exact A0125B voices; AUTH contains no sound commands, so tsm003 is not misrepresented as an activity SFX bank
runtimePolicy.exit: release activity, face, audio, camera, actor, scene-object, and control ownership exactly once

productionGate: Exact archive members, native voices, both actors and faces, MOON scene object, world composition, and fail-closed cleanup are required.
